Privacy Policy & GDPR Compliance

How ClockTime protects your privacy, complies with GDPR, CCPA, and PECR, and ensures cookieless, zero-PII web analytics.

Last updated: September 14, 2026

1. Privacy-first architecture#

ClockTime was designed from the ground up to provide accurate web analytics without compromising visitor privacy or collecting personal identifiable information (PII).

2. What we collect#

When a visitor loads a site running ClockTime, our edge collector processes:

  • Page details: Page URL, referrer URL, query parameters (excluding sensitive PII keys).
  • Device details: Browser family, operating system, device category (desktop, mobile, tablet), and screen size category.
  • Location: Country, region, and city derived from IP geolocation at the edge. The IP address is immediately discarded and never written to disk.
  • Custom Events: Action names and numeric values you choose to log (e.g., signup button clicked).

3. What we never collect#

  • No Cookies: We do not read, create, or store tracking cookies or local storage UUIDs on visitor devices.
  • No Cross-Site Tracking: Visitors are never tracked across different domain properties.
  • No IP Storage: IP addresses are never saved in databases, logs, or backups.
  • No Device Fingerprinting: We do not compute canvas hashes, audio fingerprints, or battery state identifiers.

4. Cookieless tracking & hashing#

To measure unique daily visitors without cookies, ClockTime computes a temporary daily pseudo-hash using the visitor's IP, User-Agent, and a daily rotating cryptographic salt. At midnight UTC, the salt is destroyed, making it mathematically impossible to reconstruct past visitor identities.

5. GDPR, CCPA & PECR compliance#

Because ClockTime does not store personal data or use tracking cookies, websites powered by ClockTime do not require EU cookie consent banners under the ePrivacy Directive (PECR) or GDPR.

6. Data retention and storage#

All analytics telemetry is processed and stored on encrypted, secure servers located in compliance with EU data residency standards (ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certified data centers).

7. Your privacy rights#

Site owners have full control to export or permanently purge project records at any time. Visitors can opt out of all tracking by enabling the standard Do Not Track (DNT) or Global Privacy Control (GPC) header in their browser.

8. Contact our DPO#

If you have questions about our data protection practices, you can contact our Data Protection Officer at privacy@clocktime.ph.
